newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Daewoo chairman appeals jail sentence.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Daewoo chairman appeals jail sentence.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Group said its chairman on Friday appealed against a two-year jail sentence imposed on Monday for bribing former president Roh Tae-woo.
The spokesman said a lawyer for Daewoo Chairman Kim Woo-choong submitted the appeal to the Seoul District Criminal Court.
Kim was among nine business tycoons convicted of bribing Roh. Four were sentenced to jail and the others received suspended jail sentences.
The heads of Jinro and Hanbo groups, also sentenced to two years in jail, and the chairman of Dong-Ah who was handed a 2-1/2 year jail term, have already challenged the court ruling.
Roh was sentenced to 22-1/2 years in jail for mutiny and treason on top of corruption.
